amazon_match_notes: Woot offer ASIN B0FFLTT7RP verified by the checker as the exact Cole Haan Alexandria Wallet-on-a-Chain in black (MPN P126287, UPC 198859493217).
writeup: Cole Haan's leather Alexandria wallet-on-a-chain in black is $47.02 new at Woot. Cole Haan's own site and Macy's both charge $198 for the same piece right now, so that's about 76% less. It has six card slots and a detachable 18-inch chain strap, so it works as a small crossbody. Only 1 was left when we checked.
